prompt: Compose an email to a colleague who shared an unfinished draft too late for a thorough review. Explain what feedback you can still provide before the deadline. Keep your response near 80 words.
text:
Subject: Feedback on Draft

Hi [Name],

Thanks for sending the draft. Since it arrived close to the deadline, I won’t be able to complete a thorough review. I can still do a focused pass on the main argument, clarity, structure, and any obvious errors, and flag the most important issues to address first. I may not have time to verify details or suggest extensive revisions. Please let me know if that would still be useful.

Best,  
[Your Name]
